title: askoliie (RAG Chatbot)
description: Built a production-ready AI-powered RAG chatbot using Next.js 16, FastAPI, Supabase Auth, Redis, Qdrant Vector DB, and SSE streaming, supporting ~8,000 monthly users. Developed custom orchestration for retrieval. Implemented secure JWT auth, metadata-filtered Qdrant pipeline, and a 3-layer caching architecture. Optimized response time to 700-1000ms. Evaluated quality using RAGAS.

title: Model Deployment on NVIDIA DGX Spark
description: Set up an NVIDIA DGX Spark AI infrastructure with Triton Inference Server. Deployed a quantized AI model using vLLM for inference efficiency. Implemented an optimized inference workflow using Triton.

title: PhantomPointer
description: Developed an Invisible Mouse system using computer vision to replace a physical mouse by tracking hand movements on a flat surface. Implemented real-time gesture recognition and motion tracking with OpenCV to simulate cursor movement and click actions.

title: Mistral 7B Fine-Tuning on Amazon SageMaker
description: Fine-tuned a Mistral 7B large language model using LoRA and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on Amazon SageMaker to optimize training efficiency and model performance.

title: Sports Games Image Classification
description: Trained a classification model on 13,000 images for sports games using NVIDIA DGX Spark infrastructure.

title: Agentic Voice Orchestrator (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description: Developed a production-ready, multi-tenant AI voice orchestration platform that enables organizations to create, manage, and monitor intelligent outbound calling campaigns. Built the backend using FastAPI with LangGraph for agent orchestration, integrating both Twilio and Vapi AI for scalable voice communication. Implemented secure multi-tenant architecture with PostgreSQL (Supabase), asynchronous processing, webhook-driven event handling, and real-time call lifecycle management.
